known_bounds.source_statement: For 17 inputs the table gives minimum-size bounds 63...71.
known_bounds.lower_bound_provenance: The listed 63 bound was added in 2025 based on an unpublished suggestion by Jelmer Firet and principles from Van Voorhis (1972). The best lower bound derived from published work in the current review is 60, chained from the proved 12-input value.

T099-C01.survey_scope_note: The current Dobbelaere table lists size bounds 63 to 71, but 63 is an unpublished and unrefereed strengthening. The strongest lower bound derived from published work in this review is 60. The 71 network is a feasible upper bound, not a proof that 71 is minimal. The separately proven optimal depth of 10 does not determine the minimum network size.
